accepted_gaps.title: Unvalidated cross-scale state map
accepted_gaps.rationale: Sources establish recurring macroscopic phenomena but not a held-out, mechanism-aware map across domains.

accepted_gaps.title: Conflation of order, correlation, and responsiveness
accepted_gaps.rationale: Midge, bird, and fish evidence motivates separate observables.

accepted_gaps.title: Insufficient predictive falsification
accepted_gaps.rationale: The literature identifies untested model assumptions and motivates inference from behavioral data.

accepted_gaps.title: Missing geometry and delay moderators
accepted_gaps.rationale: Fluid, obstacle, communication, and sensing constraints differ across systems.

accepted_gaps.title: Universal-coefficient claim unsupported
accepted_gaps.rationale: Evidence supports conditional comparisons, not one coefficient set for all taxa and media.
